report.summary: daedalus/spine/ledger.py: crash-safe intent ledger over SQLite, recording intents before effects and appending events for state transitions.
risks: READS|daedalus/spine/ledger.py|Read-only mode still creates -wal/-shm sidecars; file content unchanged but filesystem is touched.
CLAIMS|daedalus/spine/ledger.py|Intent before effect: record_intent commits before the external effect, so crash window is only for effects without identifiable keys.
CLAIMS|daedalus/spine/ledger.py|Append-only in spirit: rows are never updated, only appended events.
CLAIMS|daedalus/spine/ledger.py|Double resolution is rejected (IntentAlreadyResolved), not silently absorbed.
todos: daedalus/spine/ledger.py|constant|ROOT|Repository root path, used for default DB path.
daedalus/spine/ledger.py|class|UnknownIntent|Raised when no intent with given id exists.
daedalus/spine/ledger.py|class|Intent|Dataclass representing a recorded intent with current state.
daedalus/spine/ledger.py|class|SpineLedger|Crash-safe ledger managing SQLite storage of intents and events.
daedalus/spine/ledger.py|function|default_db_path|Returns the ledger path, overridable by env var.
